Casey County, Kentucky, which takes its name from his great-grandfather, Colonel William Casey. His grandfather, Colonel Robert Paxton, organized a company and fought with General Jackson at New Orleans in 1814. His father, Colonel William Casey Paxton, also a native of Kentucky, commanded a company of volunteers in the Mexican War and served in the State Legislature.
